note: An ear game of the leaps around the 5th: the 4th, the tritone, the 5th and the two 6ths, every answer button named with its plain meaning, and the why says how to hear the tritone and the minor 6th against Sol. One feel to reach, no count.

exercise.title: Around the 5th
exercise.why: The tritone is a half step under Sol and the minor 6th a half step over it, so you can hear each of them as a 5th that is a little too small or a little too wide.

cells.text:
Press Start below to hear the first question: the game plays Do, then a note a 4th, a tritone, a 5th or a 6th above it.
Hum the second note back. Then pick its name: P4 for the 4th, TT for the tritone, P5 for the 5th, m6 for the minor 6th, M6 for the major 6th, and press Next below for another leap.
Practice until the tritone and the minor 6th stand out from the 5th before you hum them.
